title: The Godfather
author: Mario Puzo
summary: Vito Corleone is the head of a powerful New York crime family, and when an attack on him sets off a gang war, his youngest son Michael, who wanted no part of the business, is pulled into it.
readIf: you want a richly detailed crime saga about loyalty, family and power.
skipIf: you'd rather not read a long, violent story with dated attitudes toward women.

pairings.reason: A leaner, bleaker crime story about violence and fate, with a very spare style.
A different kind of revenge epic, with elaborate plans and a more romantic spirit.
Another big American saga about loyalty among tough men, with more warmth.
